async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to load and elements to be ready
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Select the first template by clicking the 'Use template' radio button
    await page.get_by_role("radio", name="Use template").first.click()
    # Wait for the form to load after template selection
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Fill in the project name as 'agi_index'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name").fill("agi_index")
    # Click the 'Create project' button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
